column1: I walk alone through the city
Every light is fading into blue
The night is long and cold
I keep your voice inside my head
We were young and we were free
Running down the empty street
The radio is playing low
Tomorrow never comes too soon
Your laughter echoes in the hall
I wrote your name upon the sand
And watched the ocean take it away
Every word I never said
Is burning slowly in my chest
The city lights are calling me
I hear the rain against the glass
We danced until the morning came
And nothing ever felt the same
Hold me closer, hold me tight
Don't let go before the light
The river carries all my fears
Down to the sea of yesterday
I've been waiting for so long
Singing the same old song
There's a fire in your eyes
That nobody can see
Maybe tonight we'll find a way
The stars are falling one by one
My heart is beating like a drum
Underneath the silver moon
Summer days are gone too soon
I remember every line
Of the letter you wrote me
The world is spinning way too fast
Nobody knows where we belong
Walking home beneath the rain
I can't forget the way you smiled
Love is a word I learned too late
Open the window, let it in
The music plays inside my soul
Freedom is a song we sing
